steps: 1. Enable **Allow Crafting Bench in Mission** and enter an Adventure mission.
2. Open the in-mission inventory, then open **Crafting** once. Complete one salvage, one property or trait reroll, and one illusion application.
3. Close and reopen inventory and repeat one action. Confirm there is one working bench, not a duplicate or a Keep-only forge.
4. Turn the setting off and reopen inventory. In separate controls, enter Chaos Wastes and launch with Crafting in Modded disabled.
5. Confirm Crafting is safely unavailable in all three controls while other permitted tabs still work. Exit normally and attach the newest logs.
assertions: Adventure plus the enabled setting and CIM exposes the mission-safe standard bench. All three actions succeed without duplicate entry, missing resources, EAC errors or crashes. Setting off, Chaos Wastes or no CIM leaves Crafting unavailable.
In a mission with the setting on, open the forge via mod API, salvage/reroll/apply-skin a sandbox item, assert state change and no crash; absent in deus and when off.
